coach_note: Fri Nov 27 - Admirals Cove, legs and hips plus a steady Zone 2 walk. Recovery is only middling after Thanksgiving: HRV 40, resting HR 51 (up from 46-47), body battery 33 this morning. Sleep was fine at 7.6 h. So this is a solid-but-not-heroic day: top sets taken past the number on the machines that are safe to push, hamstrings kept light, and the cardio at a steady Zone 2 rather than anything hard. Legs were last loaded Monday at Portofino (leg press 115 x20, extension 90 x18); the Admirals machines read heavier - 160 x20 on this leg press on Nov 14 - so the numbers below are this gym's, not Portofino's. Note the Pec Fly / Reverse Fly machine here is in kg; nothing else is. This is the last day of the training week and every goal is already met, so nothing here is chasing a count.

exercises.note: Main cardio, done first. 5 min flat easy, then 30 min at 3.6-3.8 mph on a 5-7% grade - that's the incline-walk recipe from the lactate test that puts you at 121-131 without running. 5 min flat to finish. Keep it under 132; today is not the day for Zone 3.
Nov 14 was 80/120/160 x30/30/20. Two warm-ups, then 180 AMRAP - stop when the knees drift in or the lower back lifts off the pad. 15 clean reps is the target; 20 means 200 next time.
Nov 16 was 45/55 x15 with room. Warm-up, then 70 AMRAP with a 1-second hold at the top.
Hamstrings stay easy: 2 x 12 at 35, slow on the way back, stop with 4-5 reps in hand. Not an AMRAP.
New machine for the log. Start light to learn it: 2 sets of 12, a 2-second squeeze at the top, ribs down. Note the weight you land on.
Nov 16 was 65/75/85 x10. Warm-up at 65, then 95 AMRAP.
Nov 16 was 45/55/65 x15. Warm-up at 50, then 80 AMRAP.
One AMRAP set, hands across the chest, then one set of 15.
Fixed 2 x 20 - lower back, not an AMRAP.
Optional finisher, 8 minutes easy - lats and shoulders from a different angle than the hangs, and nothing in it to hurt a hamstring. Skip if the body battery says so.
